• FRUIT FLAVORED SNACKS: Fruit by the Foot Variety Pack featuring Berry Tie-Dye, Blue Raspberry, and Strawberry Tie-Dye flavors; With wild flavors and colors, the possibilities for fun are endless

  • FUN KIDS SNACK: These individually wrapped snack bags are the perfect treat to include in a packed school lunch box

  • GLUTEN FREE: Tasty gummy treats made without gluten, gelatin, or artificial flavors; Contains vitamin C for snacks you can feel great about

  • ON-THE-GO SNACK: These fruit flavored sheets strips are the perfect addition to your pantry and a snack every member of the family will love

  • CONTAINS: 4.5 oz, 6 ct
features:
Features

Three Fan-Favorite Snacks in One Box
Includes a mix of Fruit Roll-Ups, Fruit by the Foot, and Gushers—each with unique textures and fruity flavors.

Gluten-Free & Gelatin-Free
Safe for kids and adults with dietary restrictions, made without gluten or gelatin.

No Artificial Flavors
Bursting with real fruit taste using only natural flavors.

Good Source of Vitamin C
Each pouch delivers a boost of vitamin C to support immune health.

Low in Calories
Around 80–90 calories per pouch, making it a sensible sweet treat.

Portable & Pre-Portioned
Individually wrapped for easy lunchbox packing, snacking on-the-go, or portion control.

Kosher Certified
Suitable for various dietary needs and preferences.

Benefits

Perfect for Kids and Families
A fun, fruity mix that appeals to all ages—ideal for school lunches, after-school snacks, or movie nights.

Snack Variety Without the Guesswork
Enjoy different flavors and formats in one convenient package—no need to choose just one favorite.

Convenient and Mess-Free
No utensils needed, and no sticky hands—just grab and snack.

Better-for-You Indulgence
No artificial flavors, gluten-free, and a dose of vitamin C in every bite-sized pack.

Great for Sharing or Stocking Up
Family-friendly value pack that makes it easy to keep everyone satisfied.

Fun and Nostalgic
Brings back classic childhood favorites in a fresh, convenient variety format.
